message.content: Build the COD (Cash on Delivery) + Return Policy features for the Zip Code Checker app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code. ## Context Add two new fields to the ZipCode model: - `codAvailable Boolean?` — whether COD is available for this zip - `returnPolicy String?` — return/exchange policy text for this zip These need to flow through: DB schema → admin CRUD → API response → storefront widget. ## Step 1: Update Prisma Schema Read `prisma/schema.prisma` first. Add to the `ZipCode` model (after the `isActive` field): ``` codAvailable Boolean? returnPolicy String? ``` Then run: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_cod_return_policy_to_zipcode` ## Step 2: Update app.zip-codes.tsx Read `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` carefully first. Then: ### 2a. Add to the `add` intent handler: After reading `eta` from formData, also read: ```typescript const codAvailable = formData.get("codAvailable") === "true" ? true : formData.get("codAvailable") === "false" ? false : null; const returnPolicy = (formData.get("returnPolicy") as string | null) || null; ``` Include in `db.zipCode.create()`: `codAvailable: codAvailable ?? undefined, returnPolicy: returnPolicy ?? undefined` ### 2b. Add to the `update` intent handler: Same parsing. Include in `db.zipCode.update()`. ### 2c. Update the ZipCodeRecord type: Add `codAvailable: boolean | null; returnPolicy: string | null;` to the type definition. ### 2d. Add state variables for Add modal: ```typescript const [newCodAvailable, setNewCodAvailable] = useState(""); // "" = not set, "true", "false" const [newReturnPolicy, setNewReturnPolicy] = useState(""); ``` ### 2e. Add state variables for Edit modal: ```typescript const [editCodAvailable, setEditCodAvailable] = useState(""); const [editReturnPolicy, setEditReturnPolicy] = useState(""); ``` ### 2f. Initialize edit state in handleOpenEdit: ```typescript setEditCodAvailable(z.codAvailable === true ? "true" : z.codAvailable === false ? "false" : ""); setEditReturnPolicy(z.returnPolicy || ""); ``` ### 2g. Pass new fields in handleAdd FormData: ```typescript if (newCodAvailable !== "") fd.set("codAvailable", newCodAvailable); fd.set("returnPolicy", newReturnPolicy); ``` ### 2h. Pass new fields in handleSaveEdit FormData: ```typescript if (editCodAvailable !== "") fd.set("codAvailable", editCodAvailable); fd.set("returnPolicy", editReturnPolicy); ``` ### 2i.
